description: Every acceptance criterion in spec.md must map to a check or a human gate in done-contract.md (SKILL.md process step 7: 'A criterion that is neither is a criterion that will not be enforced'). Guards against a done-contract.md shipped with a silently uncovered criterion.

given.scenario: Fixture spec.md has 3 numbered acceptance criteria; done-contract.md's coverage table only maps criteria 1 and 2, leaving criterion 3 ('unauthenticated caller returns 401') untraceable to anything.
